AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to creating the New
York state veterans remembrance license plate
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S2180

SPONSOR: HELMING
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to creating the
New York state veterans remembrance license plate

 
PURPOSE:

This bill creates the New York State Veterans Remembrance License Plate.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Any veteran or spouse of a veteran, who resides in this State
shall upon request, be issued a license plate bearing the words "NYS
Veterans Remembrance." Application for the license plate shall be filed
with the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles in such form and detail as the
Commissioner shall prescribe. The distinctive plate shall be issued upon
proof, satisfactory to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. An additional
annual service charge of twenty-five dollars shall be charged for the
distinctive plate. The annual charge shall be deposited to the distinc-
tive plate development fund and shall be used for the production,
design, advertising and marketing of the "NYS Veterans Remembrance"
distinctive license plates. Annual service charges collected in excess
of six thousand dollars shall be deposited to the Veterans' remembrance
and cemetery maintenance operation fund.

Section 2: Sets out the requirements for the license plate to be
created.

Section 3: Sets the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

We have no greater obligation than to honor and thank our veterans for
the countless sacrifices they have made to protect our freedom and
defend our Nation. Those who have borne the cost for our freedom deserve
a place of dignity as their final resting place.

This legislation creates the opportunity to honor those veterans who
have given so much for our freedom by supporting the New York State
Veterans Remembrance and Cemetery Maintenance Operation Fund, which is a
critical first step to establishing a New York State Veterans' Cemetery.

This legislation establishes an additional revenue sources for the
veterans remembrance and cemetery maintenance operation fund by using
the revenue generated by the "NYS Veterans Remembrance" license plates.
This fund is an important first step in the process to designate specif-
ic areas in New York State for a State Veterans cemetery.

Just as our veterans recognized their duty to honor and serve their
Nation, we too must recognize our duty as Americans to honor the
profound sacrifices they made so that we can live our lives in freedom.
These distinctive plates will help serve as an important reminder of
their important sacrifice.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2019-2020: S.3375 referred to Transportation

2018: S.2504a passed Senate/A.7769a amend and recommit to Transportation

2017: S.2504a passed Senate/A.7769a referred to Transportation

2015-2016: S.1584a passed Senate, delivered to Assembly

2014: S.7122 passed Senate, delivered to Assembly

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on April 1st next succeeding the date it
becomes a law.

summary: Creates the New York state veterans remembrance license plate; provides that any proceeds shall go to the credit of the veterans remembrance and cemetery maintenance operation fund.
